title: I've Found a Friend, O Such A Friend
lyrics_original: I’ve found a Friend, O such a friend!
He loved me ere I knew Him;
He drew me with the cords of love,
And thus He bound me to Him;
And round my heart still closely
Twine those ties which naught can sever,
For I am His, and He is mine,
Forever and forever.
I’ve found a Friend, O such a friend!
He bled, He died to save me;
And not alone the gift of life,
But His own Self He gave me!
Naught that I have mine own I call,
I’ll hold it for the Giver,
My heart, my strength, my life,
My all are His, and His forever.
I’ve found a Friend, O such a friend!
All pow’r to Him is given,
To guard me on my onward course,
And bring me safe to heaven.
The eternal glories gleam afar,
To nerve my faint endeavor;
So now to watch, to work, to war,
And then to rest forever.
I’ve found a Friend, O such a friend!
So kind and true and tender,
So wise a Counselor and Guide,
So mighty a Defender!
From Him who loves me now so well
What power my soul can sever?
Shall life or death, shall earth or hell?
No! I am His forever.

bible_verses.english: No longer do I call you servants, for the servant doesn’t know what his lord does. But I have called you friends, for everything that I heard from my Father, I have made known to you.
But God commends his own love toward us, in that while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.
Yahweh appeared to him from afar, saying, “Yes, I have loved you with an everlasting love; therefore with loving kindness I have drawn you.”

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, thank You for being a Friend unlike any other. Even when I did not know You, You loved me and gave Your life to save me. Thank You that nothing can ever sever the ties of grace that bind my heart to Yours. Help me to walk closely with You today, resting in the quiet joy of belonging to You forever. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: Long before we ever sought after God, Jesus loved us and drew us to Himself with gentle cords of love. He is not merely a distant Creator, but a faithful Friend who surrendered His own life so we could belong to Him forever. As you worship today, rest in the quiet assurance that your place in His heart is completely secure. Allow His everlasting affection to quiet your fears and draw your soul into deeper trust and devotion.
